title: Mochizuki Honami — My Past Selves〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why is there another younger—

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (Shh!)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (The scary me hates you. You should be careful so she doesn't realize you're here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That voice... Are you the little me who was just here?)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (Yeah... I thought if I was with the grown-up me, I could go far away from the scary me.)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't think you would turn into me... I'm sorry. I really didn't know. I didn't mean to do it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Don't worry. I believe you.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Hey there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: You people came here from somewhere different, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: And if you're here, does that mean that the current, high school me is also here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well, funny story about that!
She was with us, but I guess we got separated.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We didn't really know what to do, but then this little Honami called out to us, and she's been talking to us. Isn't that right, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, uh, did you need something with the Honami who came with us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: It's nothing for you to concern yourselves with. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Too much stuff happened all at once there...
Let's take a minute and get things in order.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So you've gotten smaller physically, but you're the Honami who came in here with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And you say you can still hear the voice of the little Honami we met here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. It's a very strange feeling...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, no wonder you feel weird. There are three of you running around in here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not that we have any more experience with things like this than you do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, what's most important now is deciding what we do next. I think we'll return to our own SEKAI if enough time passes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, she... The little me says that that might not be enough.

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (The one with the strongest feelings here is the scary me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (So as long as she doesn't want to let you leave, I don't think you'll be able to.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, if we want to get back to our own SEKAI, we may have no choice but to talk to that junior high me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh, I see... But it doesn't sound like it'll be that easy to clear things up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Little Honami said the scary one hates you, right? And she sure did seem angry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, while we were talking, there was a moment where her expression changed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I noticed that, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It almost looked like she felt envious, to me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Envious?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You probably know this already, but in junior high, I ended up being ostracized by my class...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even in a full classroom, I was all alone. No one would even meet my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It made me so terribly sad... And I was very envious of everyone talking with their friends around me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, seeing that I have people who are looking out for me may have made her feel that same envy again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now that you say that, she did sort of look that way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to talk to her, properly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If she really is angry with me, or hates me, then I'm sure she has her reasons for it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Either way, it sounds like she's looking for you on her end, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She might still be nearby, so why don't we go find her and bring her back?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you sure you're ready for this, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: So, you've become physically smaller, but you're still the high school me inside. I didn't realize.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry I didn't speak up earlier. But I really do want to talk with you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why are you angry with me?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line:
......
The band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: You could have just had fun playing with Ichika and the others...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Why did you have to go pro? And why am I the leader?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Why would you shoulder such a hard role just because everyone expects it of you?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Have you already forgotten what that got us in junior high? The harder you try, the more people talk about you behind your back, and the colder their eyes get...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: And in the end, you're left all alone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember. I do.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Then why did you agree to do it?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: What happens if everyone doesn't see eye to eye and breaks apart, and you can't make it all fit back together?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Or what happens if the three of them feel one way, and I'm the odd one out?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: What if... If I end up...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and the others wouldn't ignore us just because of a difference in opinion.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: You...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: You...don't know that...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: All our classmates were so nice too, and then suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What happened then... Really, truly hurt.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As I am now... Together with them, I'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: How can you sound so sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've grown just a little bit stronger since then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've thought about what it means to truly be kind... Practiced how to tell others what I'm feeling directly and honestly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did sort of end up in a fight with Shiho about that, but in the end, she understood how I felt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And when they were scouted for their debut, Honami made sure to lay out what mattered most to the four of them, and made sure Leo/need would keep existing as itself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still inexperienced, and there are times when I worry that I'm not as good a leader as I ought to be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But when we disagree on something, we sit down and talk it out...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And if something happens that's too big for me to bear on my own, the others are there to help me carry the weight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, Leo/need is the four of us, all together.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Can I really...believe that?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Can I really believe in...myself, and Ichika, and Saki, and Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No... I want you to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What happened to us in junior high opened my eyes to many things, and it helped me grow a little, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, don't worry. Believe in me... And believe in yourself, too.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being scared of you. Even though you're me, too.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: But we're all together now, forever.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, we're back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Phew... It felt a bit touch-and-go there for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What a strange SEKAI that was. I never thought I'd have a conversation with myself like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was definitely surprised by all the different Honamis we saw.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm sure that's because that SEKAI was born from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did think so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The little me said she was made from my feelings, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the junior high me in that SEKAI wasn't really how I remember myself being at that time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet that's because of the specific feelings that Honami was born from.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is just my guess here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I wonder if maybe she was born from the anxiety and fear you feel toward your position as leader, getting tied up in your past trauma?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, we won't pry. Especially since you faced those fears and found your own answer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And you really looked cool doing it, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cool? I wouldn't say that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Just like I told her, I still feel lacking as a leader...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I want to live up to everyone's hopes, and their belief that I can do it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And of course, I want to contribute properly, as a member of the band.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll need to make sure I give some serious thought to what I can do as leader to make that happen.)
